item.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.4.6b
item.description:
Greetings, Descendants.

We would like to inform you about the details for The First Descendant Hotfix 1.4.6b.

Descendants, please reconnect to the game after the patch to ensure smoother gameplay.

■ Patch Date- 10.22.2026(Thu) 20:00 PDT

■ Platforms- Steam, XBOX, PS5

item.title: V3.4.0 EXP
item.description:
Hello Survivors! 

Digging through a packed backpack in the middle of a horde is about to get much easier. V3.4.0 adds a search bar and filters to your backpack and containers, so you can find what you need in seconds. Stay alert, spend less time searching, and more time surviving!

item.title: Improvements to DIRCM
item.description:
The missile used to know where it was at all times, then it took a laser in the seeker!

In the upcoming major update, we’ll be releasing an overhauled version of DIRCM that addresses several shortcomings.

item.title: HOI IV Dev Diary | Romania: A Flawed Democracy
item.description:
Generals!

Greetings, I’m Norrman and I’ve been working with Marijn and Alex on the upcoming Romania Focus Pack and I will cover the first part of this Dev Diary.

Some quick notes about me before I move on to the content that has been my main focus. I’ve been playing Hearts of Iron IV since about a month after the game’s release and I’ve been modding the game for a bit over 4 years at this point.
